description: The advertised progress interfaces cover autosplit loading but silently omit explicit-device loading.
trigger: Call load(device=..., callback=...) or iterate load_gen(device=...).
expected_behavior: Receive callback or iterator progress for the selected loading mode.
actual_behavior: The device branch calls unchanged _load_single(progressbar, device), which neither invokes the callback nor yields progress. Iterating load_gen still performs loading but produces no progress tuples.

verification.description: Compared the unchanged explicit-device callee with the autosplit additions. Whole-tree caller search found explicit-device load calls in tests/generator_stresstest.py, whose inspected setup uses cuda:1 and optionally cuda:2 without callbacks. Those existing calls demonstrate branch use, not an existing notification failure; the omission affects callers adopting the new interfaces.
verification.limits: Source inspection only; external callers and dynamic invocation were not established.

finding.description: The previously recorded explicit-device progress omission is carried over unchanged.
finding.trigger: Use load_gen(device=...) expecting yielded progress, or load(device=..., callback=...) expecting callback notifications.
finding.expected_behavior: Receive loading progress through the requested interface.
finding.actual_behavior: The explicit-device branch calls _load_single, which only updates its progress bar. Loading can finish and reach the new cleanup without yielding progress or calling the callback.

verification.description: Compared the parent explicit-device branch and _load_single with the task diff. Whole-tree load_gen search found Model.load and two loading-example callers; the examples use autosplit and exhaust their iterators. The omission reaches direct explicit-device iterator consumers and explicit-device callback users through Model.load, not the inspected example calls.
verification.limits: No runtime reproduction; literal caller searches do not establish external or dynamically dispatched usage.
